eventMetadata.context_description: SMU Mustangs' explosive offense, ranking top-five nationally in scoring and total yards, anchors the 73.5% implied probability against Miami (OH) RedHawks in the LendingTree Bowl. The Mustangs (11-2) enter on a high note after a competitive ACC Championship loss to Clemson, with quarterback Preston Stone healthy per official reports and dual-threat back Brashard Smith fully available, bolstering their no-huddle attack. Miami (OH) (11-3), MAC runners-up, boasts a stout run defense that limited foes to 3.2 yards per carry but faces a step up against SMU's balanced attack averaging 269 rushing yards lately. Neutral-site dynamics and SMU's superior depth reflect trader consensus on a multi-score edge, though RedHawks' upset potential lingers from gritty road wins.
